prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Katy, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1400; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just keep it to the accident details, if that's okay.

Q: That's fine. For the record, can you confirm you were the driver of the vehicle involved in the collision at the intersection in Katy, Texas?

A: Yes, I was driving my own car. I was heading through the intersection on the green light.

Q: Can you describe the direction you were traveling and what happened as you entered the intersection?

A: I was going straight. Another car came from the cross street on my right side and didn't stop. I hit my brakes but there was no time. It hit my driver's side door.

Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?

A: Yes, I was belted in.

Q: Did the airbags deploy?

A: No, they didn't. The impact pushed my car sideways into the curb.

Q: Did you receive medical attention after the collision?

A: Yes, I went to the emergency room later that same day. They told me I had a neck and back strain.

Q: Are you still experiencing pain or stiffness?

A: Yes. My neck is stiff when I turn my head, and my lower back aches after sitting for a while. I've been doing physical therapy twice a week.

Q: Have you missed any work because of your injuries?

A: I've been out a few days and I'm working on modified duty now.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I just want my car fixed and my medical bills taken care of.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
